软件名称：ODA File Converter（Open Design Alli.en: Software: ODA File Converter (provided free of charge by the Open Design Alliance; not open-source software). One-click install: after you accept ODA's terms of use, the installer is downloaded from the ODA website, its ODA digital signature is checked and a test drawing is converted; if both pass, it is installed in this application's data folder. You can also download and install it yourself from the website, then select its install location; an installation in the system's default location is found automatically. When it is not installed: DXF drawings are translated as usual; DWG drawings need it. Official download: {0}

Vous pouvez aussi le télécharger et l'installer vous-même depuis le site, puis sélectionner son emplacement d'installation ; une installation à l'emplacement par défaut du système est détectée automatiquement.
